subject.title: fix(mac-gateway): write launchd stderr to a log file and surface it in diagnostics (#90711)

question: Should macOS file-backed launchd stderr be allowed to land before retention covers the actual supervisor log paths?
rationale: The change restores otherwise-lost crash evidence, but the current adjacent retention implementation targets state-directory logs rather than the `Library/Logs/openclaw` sinks restored here.

options.title: Require bounded supervisor logs
options.body: Land only after retention covers `resolveGatewaySupervisorLogPaths` and real macOS fresh-install and upgrade proof is supplied.

options.title: Accept temporary growth risk
options.body: Restore stderr now while explicitly accepting unbounded supervisor-log growth until follow-up retention work lands.

options.title: Keep stderr suppressed
options.body: Retain `/dev/null` until a bounded early-error capture design is ready.

recommendation.title: Require bounded supervisor logs
recommendation.body: Land only after retention covers `resolveGatewaySupervisorLogPaths` and real macOS fresh-install and upgrade proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans both the launchd write path and diagnostic consumers involved in this decision.
